title: calipers
description: Overview of hosts monitored by calipers: fleet totals, one row per host, and time series per host. Select hosts with the host variable.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Hosts that reported calipers_build_info.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets of the selected jobs that are down.

panels.title: CPUs
panels.description: Logical CPUs across the selected hosts.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Non-idle share of all CPUs on the selected hosts.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 1 - available / physical. ARC counts as available.

targets.expr: 1 - sum(mem_available_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / sum(mem_physical_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Physical memory across the selected hosts.

panels.title: Network in
panels.description: All interfaces except loopback.

panels.title: Network out
panels.description: All interfaces except loopback.

panels.title: Fullest filesystem
panels.description: Highest used share of any monitored filesystem.

targets.expr: max((disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / (disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} + disk_avail_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Fullest pool
panels.description: Highest allocated share of any ZFS pool.

targets.expr: max(zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} / zfs_pool_size_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Problems
panels.description: ZFS pools and vdevs not ONLINE, unhealthy SMART devices, failing HTTP and DNS probes and unsynchronized clocks. Details in the Health row.

targets.expr: count(zfs_pool_health{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", state!="ONLINE"} == 1) or vector(0) + count(zfs_vdev_state{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", state!="ONLINE"} == 1) or vector(0) + count(smart_device_healthy{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0) or vector(0) + count(http_response_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0) or vector(0) + count(dns_query_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0) or vector(0) + count(chrony_synchronized{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Collector errors
panels.description: Failed collector runs in the selected time range.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: One row per host at the end of the time range. Click a host name to show only that host.

targets.expr: 1 - sum by (host) (rate(cpu_all_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (host) (rate(cpu_all_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval]))
max by (host) (system_load1{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / max by (host) (system_cpus{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})
1 - sum by (host) (mem_available_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / sum by (host) (mem_physical_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})
sum by (host) (swap_used_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / sum by (host) (swap_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} > 0)

max by (host) ((disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / (disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} + disk_avail_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}))
max by (host) (zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} / zfs_pool_size_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

count by (host) (zfs_pool_health{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", state!="ONLINE"} == 1 or zfs_vdev_state{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", state!="ONLINE"} == 1) or count by (host) (calipers_build_info{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) * 0
count by (host) (smart_device_healthy{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0) or count by (host) (calipers_build_info{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) * 0

panels.title: CPU busy by host
panels.description: Non-idle share of all CPUs per host.

targets.expr: 1 - sum by (host) (rate(cpu_all_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (host) (rate(cpu_all_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU by mode (selected hosts)
panels.description: Share of all CPUs on the selected hosts, by mode.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(cpu_all_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum(rate(cpu_all_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Load (1m) per CPU by host
panels.description: 1-minute load average divided by logical CPUs; above 1 means runnable threads wait.

targets.expr: max by (host) (system_load1{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / max by (host) (system_cpus{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Processes by state (selected hosts)
panels.description: Sleeping and idle (kernel threads) left out, they dwarf the rest.

panels.title: Average CPU frequency by host
panels.description: Mean clock over all cores. Needs frequency = true in [inputs.cpu].

panels.title: Memory used by host
panels.description: 1 - available / physical. ARC counts as available.

targets.expr: 1 - sum by (host) (mem_available_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / sum by (host) (mem_physical_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: Memory by state (selected hosts)
panels.description: FreeBSD page queues. ZFS ARC is part of wired, see the next panel.

panels.title: ZFS ARC and swap by host

targets.expr: (disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) / (disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} + disk_avail_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})
zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} / zfs_pool_size_bytes{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}

panels.title: Disk throughput by host
panels.description: Reads up, writes down. Sum over all disks.

panels.title: Busiest disk by host
panels.description: Busy share of the busiest disk per host (devstat busy time).

panels.title: Disk operations by host
panels.description: Reads up, writes down.

panels.title: Disk latency by device
panels.description: Average time per read or write operation.

targets.expr: sum by (host, device) (rate(diskio_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", type=~"read|write"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (host, device) (rate(diskio_operations_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", type=~"read|write"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)

panels.title: ZFS pool I/O by host
panels.description: Reads up, writes down.

targets.expr: sum by (host, pool) (rate(zfs_pool_bytes_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", type="read"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (host, pool) (rate(zfs_pool_bytes_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", type="write"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Traffic by host
panels.description: All interfaces except loopback. In up, out down.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(net_receive_errors_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", interface!~"lo[0-9]*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(net_send_errors_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", interface!~"lo[0-9]*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (host) (rate(net_receive_drops_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", interface!~"lo[0-9]*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(net_send_drops_total{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", interface!~"lo[0-9]*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TCP connections and pf states by host
Problems
panels.description: Everything that is unhealthy right now: ZFS pools and vdevs not ONLINE, failing SMART health, failing HTTP and DNS probes, unsynchronized clocks. Empty means all good.

targets.expr: max by (host, check, subject) (label_replace(label_join(zfs_pool_health{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", state!="ONLINE"} == 1, "subject", " ", "pool", "state"), "check", "ZFS pool", "", "") or label_replace(label_join(zfs_vdev_state{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host", state!="ONLINE"} == 1, "subject", " ", "pool", "vdev", "state"), "check", "ZFS vdev", "", "") or label_replace(label_join(smart_device_healthy{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0, "subject", " ", "device"), "check", "SMART", "", "") or label_replace(label_join(http_response_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0, "subject", " ", "method", "url"), "check", "HTTP", "", "") or label_replace(label_join(dns_query_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0, "subject", " ", "server", "domain", "record_type"), "check", "DNS", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(chrony_synchronized{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"} == 0, "subject", "not synchronized", "", ""), "check", "chrony", "", ""))

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: SMART health per drive. Drives in standby are not woken up and keep their last values.

panels.title: ZFS and disk errors
panels.description: Only series with errors appear.

targets.expr: sum by (host, pool, vdev) (zfs_vdev_errors{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) > 0

panels.title: HTTP probes
panels.description: Latency averaged over the selected time range.

targets.expr: max by (host, method, url) (http_response_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})
max by (host, method, url) (http_response_status_code{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

histogram_sum(sum by (host, method, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__range]))) / histogram_count(sum by (host, method, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__range])))
max by (host, method, url) (http_response_tls_cert_expiry_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}) - time()

panels.title: DNS probes
panels.description: Latency averaged over the selected time range.

targets.expr: max by (host, server, domain, record_type) (dns_query_success{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})

histogram_sum(sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__range]))) / histogram_count(sum by (host, server, domain, record_type) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__range])))
max by (host, server, domain, record_type) (dns_query_answers{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"})
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, url) (rate(http_response_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, server) (rate(dns_query_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", realm=~"$realm", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: CPU by process
panels.description: Summed over all PIDs and modes; 1 = one full CPU.

panels.title: Collector duration p99
panels.description: Slowest hosts dominate.

panels.title: Collector errors
panels.description: Only collectors with errors appear.
